title: Grocery Store Food Distribution Inefficiency Explained
reason: Discusses inefficiencies in food distribution and the transition to sustainable practices.

tasks.task: Explain the inefficiencies in food distribution with current statistics.

subtasks.text: Note that the average piece of produce travels 1500 miles and is 10 days old.
Observe that produce loses half of its nutritional value and half goes bad during distribution.

tasks.task: Describe the historical perspective on selling fresh food.

subtasks.text: Mention that people initially found grocery stores selling fresh food ridiculous.
Highlight the goal of working with consumers to transition to a more sustainable food system.
